voice.name: Open Sector - Artillery
voice.description: Sturdy middle-aged male gun sergeant in his forties, thick barrel chest, booming low baritone with a gruff rural accent, practical and no-nonsense, barking orders at his loader like a veteran field gun crew chief, proud of his big gun, short and punchy delivery.
voice.sample: Right, lad, drop the trail and dig in those spades! Shell in, breech closed, range four thousand. Stand clear and cover your ears. Fire! Now that is how you knock on a door.

ready: Gun crew reporting, one oh five ready.
special: Gun's set. Give us a target.

fire.prompt: Distant, thunderous boom of a World War 2 105mm field howitzer firing in an open field, the blast shaking the ground and echoing off the hills for seconds.

move.prompt: Heavy towed field gun being hauled, iron wheels creaking and rolling on gravel, chains clinking, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Field gun hit by explosion, ammunition crates detonating, metal debris clattering down, medium distance, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Heavy artillery gun trail legs dropped and spread with metal clank, spades hammered into dirt, breech opened and shell slid in, close, no music, no voice

reload.prompt: Artillery breech block opening, heavy brass shell casing ejected with a clang, new shell rammed in, breech slamming shut, close, no music, no voice
